description: This file defines the Request class implementing the RequestInterface for HTTP requests within the PSR-7 standard. It includes a constructor to initialize HTTP request properties such as method, URI, headers, body, and protocol version, and uses traits for message and request-specific behavior.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request message with properties for method, URI, headers, body, and protocol version. Implements the RequestInterface and uses traits for message behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Request object with specified method, URI, headers, body, and protocol version. Converts URI string to UriInterface if necessary, sets headers, and manages the request body stream.
